name: Sunland Towne Centre
summary: Sunland Towne Centre is a well-established community shopping center in western El Paso, managed by Kite Realty Group. Serving the growing Sunland Park area with convenient retail, dining, and services, the center has earned strong community support with a 4.3-star rating from over 2,600 reviews.
demographics: Sunland Towne Centre serves the western El Paso community, drawing primarily from middle-income Hispanic families and young professionals in the rapidly growing Sunland Park area. The trade area includes a mix of established homeowners and first-time buyers, with household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $75,000 annually. Shoppers typically seek convenient, value-oriented retail options for everyday needs, with strong preferences for family-friendly dining and essential services. The center benefits from its proximity to both residential neighborhoods and the New Mexico border, attracting cross-border shoppers seeking American retail brands and grocery options.
description: Sunland Towne Centre stands as a prominent shopping destination in western El Paso, strategically located on Sunland Park Drive to serve the thriving communities along the Texas-New Mexico border. Developed and managed by Kite Realty Group, a trusted name in retail real estate with an extensive portfolio across the United States, this community-focused center has become an integral part of daily life for residents in the Sunland Park area. The center offers a convenient mix of national retailers, essential services, and dining options that cater to the diverse needs of El Paso's westside families. With its accessible location and ample parking, Sunland Towne Centre provides a comfortable, open-air shopping experience that reflects the lifestyle preferences of modern Texas shoppers. The property's strong 4.3-star rating from over 2,600 Google reviews demonstrates its consistent appeal and the quality experience it delivers to the thousands of visitors who rely on it for their shopping and dining needs.
